description: Elections Commission - Declare that U. D. Dharmasingha was elected as the member of the Number 21, Degaldoruwa of Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kundasale Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, which is an electoral process matter. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and involves the declaration of a newly elected member, making it clearly related to electoral processes and falling under the Elections category.
